name: pill
about: A Go CLI that runs the Pi coding agent on local models served by llama.cpp's router, on Apple Silicon Macs.

groups.name: The pill binary
groups.why: Compiled into the one program people install

groups.name: Around the binary
groups.why: Kept in the project but never built into pill

parts.name: commands
parts.about: One cobra command per file: pull, add, bench, serve, stop and the rest

parts.name: internal
parts.about: The packages that do the work: models, router, Pi, downloads, benchmarks

parts.name: agent skill
parts.about: The SKILL.md that teaches an agent to drive pill, embedded in the binary

parts.name: evals
parts.about: Tier 3 model evaluations: tasks, fixtures, a runner and reports

parts.name: CI and release
parts.about: Workflows that test every change, publish releases and deploy the landing page

outside.name: llama-server
outside.about: llama.cpp's server in router mode, serving the local models

outside.name: Pi
outside.about: The Pi coding agent, its models.json and skills folder, and the Node it ships with

outside.name: Hugging Face
outside.about: Where the GGUF model files are downloaded from

outside.name: macOS
outside.about: launchd, and the system tools that report memory and processes

outside.name: cloud agents
outside.about: Claude Code and Codex, the baselines evals compare local models with

outside.name: GitHub
outside.about: Runs the workflows, hosts releases and the landing page

writes the skill into Pi's skills folder
writes models.ini, starts, probes and stops the router, sends chat requests
merges the pill provider into models.json, launches pi

reads memory and processes, manages the LaunchAgent
pulls, adds and stops models through the CLI
runs each task with a local model
runs the same tasks as baselines
